conditionReports.summary: Adjacent Lake Knobesholm loop reviews generally report easy/good/free parking/not crowded. A 2025-08-27 review mentions no markings and a difficult bridge without railing/stones, but this is adjacent-loop evidence and not confirmed as Hallandsleden mainline.

conditionReports.title: LC Energi Knobesholm solar-park consultation
conditionReports.summary: Future access/currentness risk near road 675/Knobesholm. Consultation says Hallandsleden passes through part of the project area and access may be affected compared with today; field lane found planning horizon with permit application spring 2026, construction autumn 2029 and operation spring 2030. Not a current closure.

sourceContradictions.details: Current Hallandsleden page/API/GPX says Vessigebro - Frodeparken, 29 km/28.9 km. Naturkartan slug and visible length preserve old Skattagard-Frodeparken/23.0 km; OSM relation 7398313 and many route apps preserve old Skattagard-Frodeparken boundaries.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use current official GPX/API geo_json and current Hallandsleden page as canonical. Preserve stale sources only as risk notes.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden API geo_json matches current GPX from Vessigebro to Frodeparken. Nested line.geometry starts near Skattagard and extends east beyond the current Frodeparken endpoint.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use geo_json/GPX; suppress line.geometry for current M8.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan shape corroborates current route, but slug and visible length remain stale.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use Naturkartan for geometry corroboration only, not canonical title/distance/metadata.

sourceContradictions.details: Official section and place names use Frodeparken and endpoint shelter is at the route end, but rules lane did not find M8 GPX intersecting the NVR Frodeparken reserve polygon and estimated endpoint around 700 m west of the polygon.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Model Frodeparken reserve as endpoint-adjacent/S1 context unless final GIS QA proves direct overlap.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/source pages provide shelter/reserve access context but no close transit and no confirmed named car park. Rural bus and Oskarstrom rail options are several kilometers away.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Record endpoint access as weak/caveated; do not overstate public transport or parking.

sourceContradictions.details: Official service text says fill water in Vessigebro and no water at campsites; official places API returned no dricksvatten record for M8. Some old field/service context mentions Abild/backens cafe but is not current verified public water.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Do not add drinking-water pins. Add a section water warning and endpoint resupply context only.

researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: Evidence is strong enough for research-ready M8 without another targeted batch. Remaining weaknesses are explicit import caveats rather than missing source paths: Frodeparken endpoint access is poor, no current exact full-section field report was found, and Sörby/Nackagard/Backens services need coordinate/current-business verification before import.

importReadiness.endpoints: ready: start Vessigebro and end Frodeparken have high-confidence official GPX/API/Naturkartan endpoints; M7 handoff is 9.4 m and S1 handoff is exact.
